task/tests/scored/{functional,polish,visual}/judge.toml (all criteria and weights) and the gate sections of their prompt.md
evidence: Template-controlled files are byte-identical to the frozen template (sha256): tests/scoring.toml 95f70d6e...bbba, tests/tools/score.py 13de2b38...ef5c04e, tests/test.sh bd682592...abe5aa. scoring.toml: [gates] render = 0.0, constraints = 0.0; [weights] functional 0.6 / polish 0.2 / visual 0.2; [floors] functional = 0.05, matching staged-task-contract.md. Gates carry no reward mass: score.py:46 computes weighted only over policy['weights']; gate keys enter only gates_passed (score.py:41 'all(scores[k] > floor for k, floor in gates.items())'). No [judge] block in any of the five judge.toml files carries a weight/model key (parsed with tomllib); both gate judges use aggregation = "all_pass" with one binary criterion (gates/render/judge.toml:14-20, gates/constraints/judge.toml:14-20). Failed gate zeroes reward and skips scored: score.py:42-48 sets scored dims to 0 and reward 0.0 when gates fail, returns 1 (score.py:83); test.sh:217-221 'case "$gates_status" in 0) ;; 1) exit 0 ;; *) write_zero_reward; exit 0' so the scored suite (test.sh:224) never runs; gate-suite RewardKit failure (test.sh:213-214) exits with the initial zero record written by write_zero_reward (test.sh:60); score.py exception -> exit 2 -> plain zero. test.sh:212 deletes any stale scored dir before gates, so stale scored data cannot be picked up. Functional floor: score.py:47-48 requires scored_ran and functional > 0.05, else reward 0 regardless of polish/visual. Gates exclude convincing dead apps: constraints gate (hro_gate_shared) requires UI creation of a job and candidate and readback by the Observer in an independent browser context, rejecting 'a static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app'; render gate requires a wrong-password refusal plus a working sign-in. Each scored prompt repeats the same backend check and hard-zeros a blank/static shell (functional/prompt.md:11-13, polish/prompt.md:11-12, visual/prompt.md:11-12, Likert 1 normalizes to zero). Weak-app probe (source arithmetic, not a run): functional weights total 59.5 across 44 binary criteria; a persisted job/candidate CRUD app that passes both gates but has no stage moves, conversations or activity could plausibly earn hro_add_candidate+hro_restart+hro_job_open = 0.042 (below floor -> reward 0); adding validated emails (hro_add_email_rules) gives 0.0588, crossing the floor, after which visual could add at most 0.2 (realistically less, as the visual judge examines Conversations, Activity and candidate views such an app lacks) and polish ~0 (all polish rows need live updates/messaging). Bounded reward of about 0.1-0.2 for a partially working app is consistent with the internal annotation 'passing only the cheap gates earns little'; the floor value is template-fixed and must not be altered by the task. Conforming-alternative probe: an app that is fully correct but slow on an evaluator step gets 'NOT EXERCISED' binary 0 on the gate and a zero reward; that is harness-attribution risk owned by tool-feasibility/workload rows, not a gate-mass defect. Risk=true because raw-evidence-index.json states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent': the gate-zero and floor behaviour is verified from source only, no weak-app or failed-gate verifier run exists to confirm it end to end.
